title: 学习与合作的写作搭配
goal: 区分学习与合作搭配的含义，并在语境中使用常见搭配。

points.label: 区分学习与合作搭配的含义
在句子中选择合适的搭配

sources.title: 大学英语四级（CET-4）：课表
sources.used: 写作部分的课题范围、知识点与教学规格

body.p: 写学习与合作的话题时，动词常和固定的名词搭配。选词时先看意思，再看这个动词能否和这个名词连用。

body.box: The group set goals before the project and shared ideas during its first meeting.

body.p: set goals 表示确定目标；share ideas 表示交流想法。前者侧重计划，后者侧重交换意见。

cards.title: 词汇表：目标
rows: Students set goals for the coming term during their first class meeting.
Mina achieved her goal of reading daily for a month without interruption.
The class made a plan for its project before collecting any materials.
The group met the deadline for its report by sharing the work.
The team identified a problem with its schedule during the first meeting.
The partners found a solution to the delay after discussing several alternatives.
The students made a decision after discussion and informed their project tutor.
The group took action to reduce wasted paper in the study room.
The team set priorities before assigning tasks for the coming exhibition project.
Lina made a list of questions for the meeting with her tutor.

cards.title: 词汇表：习惯
rows: He developed a habit of reviewing notes weekly throughout the school year.
Students took notes during the discussion to prepare for their written reports.
She reviewed her notes before the seminar and prepared two relevant questions.
The learners asked questions after the talk about organizing a community exhibition.
Readers paid attention to the examples when comparing the two research methods.
The students managed their time carefully during the preparation of their presentation.
She kept a record of unfamiliar expressions to review them each week.
The class did research on local transport before designing its information display.
The writers checked their sources before publishing the results of their study.
The group took a break after the discussion and returned to work.

cards.title: 词汇表：合作
rows: The partners shared ideas about the exhibition at their first planning meeting.
The teams exchanged information about their findings before writing a joint report.
The students worked together on the display for their local history project.
The group divided tasks among its members according to their available time.
Jun offered help with the final draft when another member fell ill.
Nora asked for help with the chart before the group presented it.
Partners gave feedback on each other's drafts during the weekly writing session.
The team listened to advice from its tutor before revising the proposal.
The members reached an agreement on the schedule after considering everyone's commitments.
The partners solved a problem with the equipment before their presentation began.

cards.title: 词汇表：成果
rows: The learner made progress in pronunciation after several weeks of regular practice.
Volunteers gained experience in organizing events by arranging a neighborhood book exchange.
Students acquired knowledge through observation during their visits to the local garden.
Practice helped the speakers improve their skills in explaining evidence to others.
Regular practice helped him build confidence when presenting his work to classmates.
The team produced a report on its findings after reviewing all the notes.
The researchers drew a conclusion from the evidence collected during their observations.
The team achieved results through careful planning and regular discussion of its work.
The students completed a project on recycling before presenting it to their class.
The writers learned from mistakes in their drafts and revised their later work.

items.stem: Before starting work, the group chose its main aims. What did it do?
items.why: set goals 表示确定目标，main aims 指主要目标。

items.stem: Partners commented on each other's drafts. What did they do?
items.why: 对草稿提出意见对应 give feedback。

items.stem: The team ______ a solution to the scheduling problem.
items.why: find a solution 表示找到解决办法。make a solution 指配制溶液，不表示解决问题。

items.stem: The student ______ notes during the talk for later review.
items.why: take notes 表示记录笔记。

items.stem: The class divided the work among members. What did it do?
items.why: divide tasks 表示分配任务。

items.stem: After examining the evidence, the class ______ a conclusion.
items.why: draw a conclusion 表示根据证据得出结论。

groups.text: A student group prepared an exhibition about local bridges. At its first meeting, members chose their aims and assigned different jobs. Later, they discussed possible layouts and commented on one another's drafts. After checking their sources, they completed the exhibition on schedule. One member said the work had helped her become more confident about presenting information.

items.stem: Which expression describes choosing the group's aims?
items.why: chose their aims 对应 set goals。

items.stem: Which expression describes discussing possible layouts?
items.why: discussed possible layouts 对应 share ideas。第三项 give feedback 对应的是 commented on one another's drafts。

items.stem: Which phrase describes finishing on schedule?
items.why: completed ... on schedule 对应 meet a deadline。

items.stem: Which phrase describes the member's increased confidence?
items.why: become more confident 对应 build confidence。

groups.fill: A study group prepared a presentation about urban gardens. First, members set go{als} for what their audience should learn and made a pl{an} for the work. They decided to div{ide} tasks so that each member had a clear job. During their meetings, they exchanged or sha{red} ideas and gave feed{back} on early drafts. They also che{cked} sources to verify their information. After regular practice, they made prog{ress} and built confi{dence}. They met their dead{line} and completed the pro{ject} on time. Their final discussion focused on lessons for future work.

items.stem: A student records unfamiliar expressions for later reference. Which phrase describes this?
items.why: keep a record 表示保存记录，供日后查阅。

items.stem: Members agree on the schedule after a discussion. Which phrase describes this result?
items.why: reach an agreement 表示达成一致。

items.stem: The writers ______ their sources before including the figures in the report.
items.why: check sources 表示核查来源。

items.stem: Regular work helped the learners ______ progress in writing.
items.why: make progress 表示取得进步。

items.stem: A learner becomes more certain of her ability after practice. What does she build?
items.why: build confidence 表示增强信心。

items.stem: The group ______ tasks so each member could take responsibility for one part.
items.why: divide tasks 表示分配任务。
